programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: When Russia invades Ukraine, a quiet schoolteacher picks up his camera and becomes an unlikely dissident. What emerges is a chilling portrait of how propaganda seeps into everyday life and how even children are drawn into the machinery of war.

programme.title: The Kenneth Williams Story: A Reputations Special
programme.desc: A look at one of Britain's funniest and most complex comic performer. From a childhood dominated by his adoring mother and bullying father to a lonely suicidal end tortured with regrets, it spans an extraordinary life and career using clips from his unforgettable performances on radio, stage, film and TV; interviews with those who knew him best.

programme.title: Horizon
programme.sub-title: The End of the Solar System
programme.desc: This is the story of how our solar system will be transformed by the ageing sun, before coming to a spectacular end in about eight billion years. Astronomers can peer into the far future to predict how it will happen by analysing distant galaxies, stars and even planets in their final moments.

programme.title: Gareth Edwards' Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: Rugby legend Gareth Edwards and wife Maureen drive a steam train through the epic Dyfi Valley before picking up speed to try rally car driving in the first of their new adventures.

programme.title: Brian Cox's Adventures in Space and Time
programme.desc: Brian explores a simple question that is causing a big stir today: what is time? Modern science shows it to be far stranger than we think. He recalls some highlights from his TV series that touch upon different sides of this physics conundrum.

programme.title: Tribe
programme.desc: Bruce Parry spends time with the Akie people of Tanzania, one of the last groups of hunter-gatherers to live on the African savannah. Bruce is forced to face his biggest fear and put his hand into a bees' nest to gather wild honey.

programme.title: Derek Jacobi Remembers... Breaking the Code
programme.desc: Sir Derek Jacobi looks back on Breaking the Code, the acclaimed 1997 drama that saw him tackling the role of Alan Turing, the mathematical genius who cracked the Enigma code.

programme.title: Breaking the Code
programme.desc: Biography of English mathematician Alan Turing, who was one of the inventors of the digital computer and one of the key figures in the breaking of the Enigma code, used by the Germans to send secret orders to their U-boats in World War II. Turing was also a homosexual in Britain at a time when this was illegal.

programme.title: Castles: Britain's Fortified History
programme.desc: Sam Willis tells the story of the English ruler who left the most indelible mark on the castle - the great Plantagenet king, Edward I who turned it into an instrument of colonisation.

programme.title: Dangerous Earth
programme.desc: Helen looks at volcanoes. With shocking eyewitness footage of eruptions, and new thermal imagery and ultra-high speed photography, we can now capture on camera the complex processes crucial to understanding how and why these forces of nature erupt.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: Celia Imrie tells the story behind one of the most groundbreaking and influential films of the sixties, 1967's Bonnie and Clyde, starring Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway.

programme.title: Bonnie and Clyde
programme.desc: Celebrated tale about the rise and fall of two violent young outlaws and their gang, based on the lives of the two most notorious American outlaws of the 1930s - Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow. The film became a cinematic landmark because of its groundbreaking, realistic and brutal scenes of violence, and won two Oscars.

programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: Hollywood portrayed them as the most glamorous outlaws in American history, but the reality of life on the run for Bonnie and Clyde was one of violence, hardship and danger. With unprecedented access to gang members' memoirs, family archives and recently released police records, the programme takes an epic road trip through the heart of depression-era America.

programme.title: The Secret World of Haute Couture
programme.desc: Margy Kinmonth meets millionaire customers and world-famous designers as she explores the anachronistic but little-explained pocket of the fashion industry known as haute couture.
